files.title: University Teaching Departments – Programmes (Courses) Fee Structure after CONSIDERATION for the Academic Session 2026-27
files.finding: No MD/MS figure: covers only the university teaching departments (BBA, MBA, MHA, PhD, B.Tech, M.Tech, B.Com, BA, BPES/MPES) and, under the medical college, M.Sc. (Medical) 80,000.00. Notes '*Subject to revision by MPPURC'.

files.title: आदेश क्र 3088/शुल्क/म.प्र.नि.वि.वि.आयोग/2026 दिनांक 03.09.2026 — शैक्षणिक सत्र वर्ष 2026-27 में संचालित पाठ्यक्रमों की शुल्क समीक्षा
files.issuer: M.P. Private University Regulatory Commission (MPPURC), Bhopal — addressed to the Registrar, Amaltas University
files.finding: Labelled 2026-27 and lists MD/MS fees ('Fee Reviewed by Fee Review Committee': e.g. Radiodiagnosis tuition 1966900 + development 347100 = 2314000; General Medicine 2065000), but it is the regulator's order, not the college's own notice — excluded by the owner's rule. Not used.
